tagline: Español de España, en plan bien.

hero.title: Spanish of Spain, de verdad.
hero.blurb: Twelve weeks. Short daily lessons. A buddy who walks you from total beginner to confident conversation, in real Castilian Spanish — the Spanish you'll actually hear in Madrid.

bullets.text: vosotros, vale, tapas, the 'th' sound. Not neutral, not Latin American.
structured around ser/estar, the past tenses, and the subjunctive so you actually finish.
15 to 30 minutes, sized to fit your day.
your progress saves to this device.

levels.title: A1 Foundations
levels.blurb: Greet, introduce yourself, order tapas, describe your day.

levels.title: A2 Building
levels.blurb: Tell stories in the past. Travel, health, everyday life.

levels.title: B1 Threshold
levels.blurb: Opinions, hypotheticals, real conversations — and the subjunctive without fear.
